outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the experimental design, not a plot presenting measured data.
Bar chart of Tmprss11b mRNA expression shows individual data points (dots) overlaid on each bar in addition to mean ± SD.
Tumor volume quantification is shown as individual dots per mouse with mean and 95% CI overlaid, so individual data points are visible.
Bar chart of Tmprss11b mRNA expression (shRNA) shows individual data points overlaid on each bar in addition to mean ± SD.
Panel E is a line plot of tumor volume over time (mean ± SEM); line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement as overlaying points would make them unreadable.
The CD4 intensity quantification bar chart shows individual data points (dots) for each field/tumor overlaid on the bars with mean ± SD.
The pERK intensity quantification bar chart shows individual data points (dots) for each field overlaid on the bars with mean ± SD.
